exchanges: ugh family reunion planning is killing me
Reunions are a lot of moving parts. What part are you stuck on?
everything lol my moms supposed to be helping but she got shingles last week so shes out of commision
Oh no, that's painful. She should definitely rest while it heals.
ya shes miserable poor thing
Hopefully the meds kick in soon for her.
so its at my uncle kenjis place bc he has the big backyard
A big backyard is perfect for a reunion.
his yard is like a museum tho hes into woodworking and theres benches and planters he built everywhere
Homemade benches will come in handy for seating everyone.
true never thought of that
Might save you renting chairs.
then theres great uncle hiroshi whos 91 and still sharp as anything
Ninety-one and sharp is impressive.
he does calligraphy every morning says its why his brain still works lol he wants to make name cards for evryone
Handwritten name cards from him would be a really special touch.
my cousin emi just started at university in waterloo so shes coming back for it
That's nice that she can make it during her first term.
shes doing engineering i think or maybe comp sci idk
Either way, first year is a big adjustment.
my sister yuki is driving down with her kids in the minivan
Road trip with kids, that's brave.
lol shes used to it they have 3
Three kids means she's probably a pro at long drives by now.
her husband liam is irish hes from dublin and he always brings this soda bread
Fresh soda bread sounds like a great addition.
its actually so good
Homemade bread usually is.
kenji wants to do a bbq but hiroshi cant really chew steak anymore
Maybe add some softer dishes alongside, like grilled fish or tofu.
oh good idea hiroshi loves grilled fish
Then that's an easy win.
hes got an old pickup he still drives to the lake every sunday which terrifies all of us
That's a lot of independence at 91, though I can see why you'd worry.
nobody can tell him anything
Sounds like he's earned the right to be stubborn.
wait no emi isnt at waterloo its guelph i always get those mixed up her roomate goes to waterloo
Got it, easy to mix up two schools that close together.
shes doing animal science i remembered
That's a good program for her.
so how many ppl do u think i need food for if its like 35
For 35 people, plan for a bit extra, maybe 40 portions, since some will go back for seconds.
ok ok and drinks
Roughly two to three drinks per person for an afternoon, plus lots of water if it's hot.
its gonna be hot for sure
Then set up some shade and a cooler near the seating.
kenji has a tent thing we can use
Perfect, that'll help a lot.
ok i think im getting there
You're making good progress. The big pieces are sorted.
oh and mr brennan from next door to kenji might come by hes a firefighter so at least someone knows first aid lol
Handy to have someone with that training around a crowd and a grill.
he usually brings his teenagers who eat everything in sight
Better add a few more portions to that 40, then.
lmao ya good point
Teenagers can easily eat double, so a little extra won't go to waste.
